DELTA STATE (PSI 7.8): Delta Deploys Over 100 Medical Personnel for Free Outreach in Oil Spillage Community
ABIA STATE (PSI 7.7): ABSOA & Youth Ministry Hold 'Future Ready' Value Orientation Drive in Isiala Ngwa South
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.6): Federal Fire Service Conducts Fire Safety Training for NYSC Corps Members at Amada Camp
OGUN STATE (PSI 7.5): Gov Abiodun Intensifies Road & Drainage Works on Ayobo-Itele-Ayetoro Corridor
OYO STATE (PSI 7.4): Ido Local Government Advances Reconstruction of 6.8km Niko Engineering Road Corridor
ENUGU STATE (PSI 7.3): Gov Mbah Addresses Recent Violence; Orders Impartial Police Investigation
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 7.2): Gov Diri Receives Top Security Chiefs; Reaffirms Commitment to Bayelsa Security
EBONYI (PSI 9.1): Gov Nwifuru flagged off fully sponsored 3-month heavy equipment training for 100 youths with NITT/FRSC certifications and approved establishing Abakaliki Cement Industry.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.9): Gov Otu established Health Quackery Law Task Force, welcomed foreign partners for Eburutu Fisheries PPP, reviewed CRAT for EUDR cocoa compliance, and backed Army 92 RRI.
JIGAWA (PSI 8.8): Gov Namadi received Crop Science Fellowship, outlining 1,700 J-AGRO agents, digital vouchers, 18k ha Hadejia irrigation, and 200 rice processing clusters.
YOBE (PSI 8.7): Gov Buni approved ₦230.62M matched by Dangote Foundation (₦461.24M total) to give 43,928 vulnerable women 20 Dangote Refinery shares each in their CSCS accounts.
KATSINA (PSI 8.6): Gov Radda backed market traders via KASEDA, swore in 3 Advisers, approved World Bank ACRISAL funding, primary school relocation, and 6-site water pipeline moves.

SOKOTO (PSI 8.5): Head of Service flagged off salary payments to 3,100 verified recruits, highlighting Gov Ahmed Aliyu's recruitment of 8,000+ total workers across health, security, and civil service.
FCT ABUJA (PSI 8.4): FCT Minister Wike proposed 'Doha City' urban model with Qatar, dismissed court claims on Qatari land, and outlined a 10-year plan with Germany for ICT and agriculture.
PLATEAU (PSI 8.3): Gov Mutfwang presented NISS paper on resolving resource conflicts, while PRUWASSA distributed toilet construction materials to 262 Langtang North households.
LAGOS (PSI 8.2): Gov Sanwo-Olu reaffirmed EU trade ties at EuroCham Gala, donated 30-seater bus to LSCDAC for grassroots mobility, and distributed maternal food packs at Igbo-Efon.
RIVERS (PSI 8.1): Gov Fubara received IGP Olatunji Disu in Port Harcourt, commending his past service as Rivers CP and pledging sustained state logistics support to police forces.
EDO (PSI 8.0): EDOHERMA mandated 4-step bank rules for health fees, Education Ministry partnered with BCHC on native languages, and Health Ministry marked Adolescent Health Day.
BENUE (PSI 7.9): Gov Alia condemned violent clash between Nongov and Mbakor communities, issuing a final warning that criminal perpetrators will face decisive legal clampdowns.
DELTA (PSI 7.8): Delta deployed 100+ medical personnel for a multi-day free health outreach in oil spillage-impacted community following Gov Oborevwori's direct assessment directive.
ABIA (PSI 7.7): ABSOA and Youth Ministry held 'Future Ready' engagement in Isiala Ngwa South, educating youths against drug abuse and promoting digital skills and voter readiness.
GOMBE (PSI 7.6): Federal Fire Service trained 2026 Batch C Stream I NYSC corps members at Amada Camp on fire prevention, electrical safety, and basic extinguishing techniques.
OGUN (PSI 7.5): Gov Abiodun intensified works on Ayobo-Itele-Ayetoro Road in Ado-Odo/Ota LGA, completing Mopol Junction drainage structure and box culverts to control flooding.
OYO (PSI 7.4): Ido LGA Council advanced ongoing reconstruction of 6.8km Niko Engineering-Ita Faaji to Opopin Road with spurs to All Saints College Road in Ibadan.
ENUGU (PSI 7.3): Gov Peter Mbah addressed Enugu citizens following political gathering shooting, reassuring public safety and ordering impartial police probe to prosecute offenders.
BAYELSA (PSI 7.2): Gov Douye Diri hosted NAF, Navy, JTF, and Army 6 Division commanders in Yenagoa, commending inter-agency synergy and pledging continuous logistics support.
